latest_release.name: Sublink Worker v2.5.0
latest_release.body:
## Release v2.5.0

### 📚 Documentation
- [Complete Changelog](https://sublink.works/updates/)
- [Deployment Guide](https://sublink.works/guide/quick-start/)
- [API Documentation](https://sublink.works/api/)

### 🚀 Quick Start
```bash
# Cloudflare Workers
npm install && npm run deploy

# Docker
docker compose up -d

# Node.js
npm run build:node && npm run dev:node
```

---
**Note:** This release was automatically created by GitHub Actions.
For detailed changes, see the [changelog](https://sublink.works/updates/).


## What's Changed
* fix: remove sing-box legacy special outbounds by @7Sageer in https://github.com/7Sageer/sublink-worker/pull/380
* fix: preserve subscription userinfo for xray by @7Sageer in https://github.com/7Sageer/sublink-worker/pull/382
* fix: default trojan security to tls by @lixiao189 in https://github.com/7Sageer/sublink-worker/pull/389
* Remove sponsorship section from README by @7Sageer in https://github.com/7Sageer/sublink-worker/pull/394
* fix(singbox): restore UDP after 1.13 regression by @7Sageer in https://github.com/7Sageer/sublink-worker/pull/402
* fix: pin sing-box rule-set downloads to DIRECT (#401, #408) by @7Sageer in https://github.com/7Sageer/sublink-worker/pull/411
* fix: build clash country groups over proxy-providers via use+filter (#403) by @7Sageer in https://github.com/7Sageer/sublink-worker/pull/412
* fix(ruleGenerators): sanitize customRules site/ip to prevent URL injection by @andesyteoss in https://github.com/7Sageer/sublink-worker/pull/414
* fix: preserve zero config TTL by @evenobserves in https://github.com/7Sageer/sublink-worker/pull/423
* fix: deduplicate exact proxy names by @evenobserves in https://github.com/7Sageer/sublink-worker/pull/422
* fix: isolate stored configs by output format by @evenobserves in https://github.com/7Sageer/sublink-worker/pull/421
* feat: 支持 AnyTLS URI 订阅解析与生成 by @luodaoyi in https://github.com/7Sageer/sublink-worker/pull/416
* fix: avoid empty direct detour for sing-box 1.14 rule-set downloads by @7Sageer in https://github.com/7Sageer/sublink-worker/pull/431
* fix: avoid direct DNS fallback for sing-box domains by @7Sageer in https://github.com/7Sageer/sublink-worker/pull/433
* fix: inline subscriptions for official sing-box by @7Sageer in https://github.com/7Sageer/sublink-worker/pull/436
* fix: preserve Reality ML-KEM option in Mihomo output by @miyunda in https://github.com/7Sageer/sublink-worker/pull/441
* fix: honor insecure=0 in share links instead of skipping cert verification by @7Sageer in https://github.com/7Sageer/sublink-worker/pull/447
* fix: keep sing-box config loadable when a node's transport is unsupported by @7Sageer in https://github.com/7Sageer/sublink-worker/pull/448
* fix: accept POST on /shorten-v2 so long links can be shortened by @7Sageer in https://github.com/7Sageer/sublink-worker/pull/450
* fix: keep VLESS encryption, xhttp options and uTLS fingerprints in Mihomo output by @7Sageer in https://github.com/7Sageer/sublink-worker/pull/449
* fix: emit sing-box shadowsocks plugin options as SIP003 strings by @7Sageer in https://github.com/7Sageer/sublink-worker/pull/451
* fix: skip malformed share links instead of failing the request by @7Sageer in https://github.com/7Sageer/sublink-worker/pull/452
* fix: drop AnyTLS nodes from sing-box 1.11 configs by @7Sageer in https://github.com/7Sageer/sublink-worker/pull/454
* fix: normalize sing-box JSON shadowsocks plugins to Clash naming by @7Sageer in https://github.com/7Sageer/sublink-worker/pull/455
* ci: load generated configs in real sing-box and Mihomo by @7Sageer in https://github.com/7Sageer/sublink-worker/pull/453
* chore: release v2.5.0 by @7Sageer in https://github.com/7Sageer/sublink-worker/pull/456

## New Contributors
* @lixiao189 made their first contribution in https://github.com/7Sageer/sublink-worker/pull/389
* @andesyteoss made their first contribution in https://github.com/7Sageer/sublink-worker/pull/414
* @evenobserves made their first contribution in https://git

detail.readme:
Sublink Worker

One Worker, All Subscriptions

A lightweight subscription converter and manager for proxy protocols, deployable on Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, Node.js, or Docker.


📚 Documentation

⚡ Live Demo · Documentation 中文文档·

Quick Start · API Reference · FAQ

## 🚀 Quick Start ### One-Click Deployment - Choose a "deploy" button above to click - That's it! See the [Document](https://sublink.works/guide/quick-start/) for more information. ### Alternative Runtimes - **Node.js**: `npm run build:node && node dist/node-server.cjs` - **Vercel**: `vercel deploy` (configure KV in project settings) - **Docker**: `docker pull ghcr.io/7sageer/sublink-worker:latest` - **Docker Compose**: `docker compose up -d` (includes Redis) ## ✨ Features ### Supported Protocols ShadowSocks • VMess • VLESS • Hysteria2 • Trojan • TUIC ### Client Support Sing-Box • Clash • Xray/V2Ray • Surge ### Input Support - Base64 subscriptions - HTTP/HTTPS subscriptions - Full configs (Sing-Box JSON, Clash YAML, Surge INI) ### Core Capabilities - Import subscriptions from multiple sources - Generate fixed/random short links (KV-based) - Light/Dark theme toggle - Flexible API for script automation - Multi-language support (Chinese, English, Persian, Russian) - Web interface with predefined rule sets and customizable policy groups ## 🤝 Contributing Issues and Pull Requests are welcome to improve this project. ## 📄 License This project is licensed under the MIT License - see the [LICENSE](LICENSE) file for details. ## ⚠️ Disclaimer This project is for learning and exchange purposes only. Please do not use it for illegal purposes. All consequences resulting from the use of this project are solely the responsibility of the user and are not related to the developer. ## ⭐ Star History Thanks to everyone who has starred this project! 🌟
